query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he stopped to sniff every single dandelion on the sidewalk, it was so cute I took like 20 photos of him holding one in his mouth. Then on the way home I popped into the corner bakery and got a fresh blueberry scone, it was still warm and crumbled all over my jacket when I took a bite. I also just remembered I need to pick up a new plant pot this weekend for the snake plant I got last month, its current pot is way too small and it's starting to tip over. Anyway, I'm having issues with my phone service right now, I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings seem to be broken, my line is suspended because of an overdue bill I forgot to pay, and I think my SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me fix this?
